title: Double click
drDigitalIntro:
A double click is two quick clicks in a row.
• Tap the trackpad twice quickly with one finger — or click the left mouse button twice fast.
• The two taps must happen fast, like a quick knock-knock.
• It is how you open files and folders.
• Try it: double-click the files below to open them.
drDigitalSuccess: Perfect double-clicking! You opened exactly the right files.
drDigitalHint: Tap twice quickly — or left-click twice fast. If a single file name gets highlighted but does not open, try again a little faster.
